name: pr-story
description: Storytelling code review: an ordered, stepper-driven narrative for pull requests, built on the git protocol.

scripts.build:cli: esbuild src/cli.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:node:* --banner:js="import { createRequire as __prstoryCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __prstoryCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist-plugin/cli.mjs
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:ui
